name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task states that whenever the ball is out of the way, the agent must carry the key then or pick it up later; Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) hard expresses exactly this. blocker_moved is a lasting condition, so the promise refreshes while it holds and closes once has_door_key holds, which is the intended reading. No goal is commanded unconditionally, so the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are valid.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
